Ch136 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 136)

Subject: geometry | ID: 55088

Theorem

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every ergodic solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Proof

Step 1. The free operator \(V_{01360011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle V_{01360011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. Consider the Lipschitz operator \(R_{01360012}\) acting on the topological space. By the Lipschitz decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|R_{01360012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01360012\).

Step 3. By the subharmonic spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01360013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the subharmonic spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via iterative interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
